decisions.reason: The source message separately changes splash control, but that impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.

The candidate's same-message MODIFY already captures the accepted 3000 RPM maximum, adjustable range, and noncontinuous maximum-speed use; the smoothness constraint remains owned by the source Requirement.
The client only identifies bowl-depth adjustment as a conditional splash-control option and does not change the current bowl size, capacity, or form.
The message conditionally permits adjusting whisk position but does not change the selected whisk head's size, style, material, or powder compatibility.
The new smoothness constraint concerns high-speed bowl mixing, not beverage flow through the dispensing system.
The high-speed mixing-quality constraint does not alter the candidate's general reliability requirement for event use.
Keeping high-speed mixing smooth does not change any bowl or spout cleaning requirement.
The source decision concerns mixing behavior at higher RPM and does not change solenoid valve actuation or dispensing isolation.
The source decision does not modify closed-valve dripping, spout sealing, or liquid containment.
The mixing-quality change is unrelated to machine brand text or placard placement.
Accepting smooth operation at higher motor speeds does not change the confirmed 120V power source or V1 battery policy.
The high-speed mixing behavior does not change the selected food-contact materials.
